title: Redis Data Structures & Persistence
recap: Redis RAM-based key-value store hai jisme Strings, Hashes, Lists, Sets aur Sorted Sets sub-millisecond operations dete hain. Memory limited hone ki wajah se TTL aur maxmemory eviction policies (noeviction vs allkeys-lru) tay karti hain ki memory bharne par data delete hoga ya write fail. Crash safety ke liye RDB periodic photos aur AOF continuous write-log milkar data recover karte hain.

demos.title: In-memory data structures
demos.summary: Strings, Hashes for sessions, Lists, Sets, and Sorted Sets in volatile RAM.

demos.title: TTL and eviction policies
demos.summary: RAM limits (maxmemory), active/lazy TTL expiration, and eviction policies (noeviction, allkeys-lru, volatile-lru).

demos.title: RDB and AOF persistence
demos.summary: Point-in-time snapshots (RDB fork/COW), write-ahead append log (AOF fsync policies), and crash recovery replay.
